title: Freehack 2.1 adapter
summary: Setting-neutral campaign-defined characters, exact host resolution, generic tracks, memory, and simultaneous sections with explicit authority/public boundaries.

source.description: Origin category used for integrity checks.

connected.description: Whether the topic had a prior connection.

reveal_after_resolution.description: Whether completed submissions may enter the public state.

turn_ticks.description: Zero for untimed; positive for timed.

archetype_id.description: Selected campaign archetype or an empty value.

creation_steps.title: Campaign procedure
creation_steps.description: Choose the versioned setting-neutral schema that defines available character fields and budgets.

creation_steps.title: Identity and modifiers
creation_steps.description: Name the character, accept an offered archetype when configured, and assign campaign-declared numeric values.

creation_steps.title: Features, inventory, and memories
creation_steps.description: Select or author permitted details while preserving configured feature counts and item budgets.

advance_track.title: Advance a generic track
advance_track.description: Apply one explicit success/failure result to a track and emit its consequence at the configured target.

cancel_submission.title: Cancel a pending action
cancel_submission.description: Remove one participant submission while its section remains open.

create_track.title: Create a generic track
create_track.description: Create an interval/target/consequence track without assuming a setting subsystem.

open_section.title: Open a section turn
open_section.description: Declare timing, mapping, abstraction, participants, and an optional public reveal policy.

preview_probability.title: Preview exact success probability
preview_probability.description: Return rational support/opposition weights and a deterministic basis-point display without consuming entropy.

disclosure.description: Whether the roll itself is public.

reveal_probability.description: Expose the exact probability preview publicly.

recall_memory.title: Resolve prior experience
recall_memory.description: Test a bounded topic obscurity, applying the declared connection adjustment before one deterministic draw.

resolve_check.title: Resolve a host-authoritative check
resolve_check.description: Draw uniformly over the nonzero support/opposition weight domain and calculate an exact signed magnitude.

disclosure.description: Whether the roll itself is public.

reveal_probability.description: Expose the exact probability preview publicly.

resolve_section.title: Resolve simultaneous submissions
resolve_section.description: Require the applicable submission set, order it by declared participants, and retain authority outcomes atomically.

submit_action.title: Submit one simultaneous action
submit_action.description: Store one participant action privately while publishing only receipt progress until resolution.

timeout_section.title: Time out a section turn
timeout_section.description: Close a timed section after its duration and deterministically identify submitted and missing participants.

ordered_submissions.description: Private actions and outcomes in resolution order.

covered_files_or_sections: Freehack 2.1 core mechanics: modifiers, rolls, tracks, sections, creation, and memory.
Exact integer behavior cross-checked against the official roll tool.
provenance.attribution: Freehack was created by Amini Allight and released under CC0-1.0; Weave's adapter implementation, fixtures, schemas, and explanatory copy are independently authored.

additional_artifacts.purpose: Exact source text reviewed for the core behavior boundary.
Publication metadata reviewed with the source revision.
Official executable reference used to cross-check result bands.

notices: Only hashes and independently authored behavior are bundled; the upstream PDF, icon, stylesheet, and page layout are excluded.
Freehack public payloads must be produced by the dedicated projection API; generic receipt projection retains host-event envelopes and is not a player transport.
provenance.compatibility_statement: Freehack is named only to describe rules compatibility. This project is independent and does not imply endorsement by the original creator.
